source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第三节

textbook_summary: V1-V6 have rS morphology with R/S < 1.
QRS voltage is low in lead I.
The frontal electrical axis deviates rightward.
Increased P amplitude is common; the right-atrial P example may be explicitly combined with this morphology.

authored_choices.repolarization: Reference ST/T are retained; this does not assert that the disease necessarily has normal ST/T.
authored_choices.atrial: P morphology is selected independently; right-atrial abnormality is not added automatically.
authored_choices.construction: Authored coefficients and existing smooth components, not exact samples from textbook cases.

limitations: ECG morphology only; no pulmonary pathology, pulmonary arterial pressure or perfusion is defined.
The axis is fixed; a continuous-axis interface is not implemented.
Does not represent all chronic cor pulmonale morphologies.
Behavior on Windows hardware is not yet verified.
